title: Open up hours outside opening times
summary: Right-click a closed time → Enable hours: opens those hours for that day only, as an exception schedule.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows in grey what is outside opening hours.

steps.title: Right-click a closed time
steps.details: On a grey band (outside opening hours or a closure). On an open time the option does not show up.

steps.title: Enable hours…
steps.details: Opens that day's hours starting at the time you clicked.

steps.title: To
steps.details: It must be after "From". Below you can see what changes and the resulting hours for the day.

steps.title: Reason
steps.details: Optional. Saved as the exception schedule's note (e.g. extended hours for surgery).

steps.title: Enable
steps.details: It only changes that day. It shows up in Business Setup → Exception schedules, where it can be reviewed or removed.
